sources.title: AirTrunk SYD2 Sydney North location page
sources.publisher: AirTrunk Operating Pty Ltd
sources.attribution: AirTrunk
sources.summary: AirTrunk's SYD2 Sydney North page welcomes visitors to 'one of Australia's largest hyperscale data centres (by megawatts)' and describes a carrier-neutral hyperscale campus 'with multiple diverse buildings and a total capacity of 120+MW', set on 4.2 ha with 29,000 m2 of technical data hall area and 24 data halls, a 132 kV diverse high-voltage feed, design PUE 1.15 and '100% availability backed by industry leading SLAs'. Its project section ('Date: 2019 - ongoing') says SYD2 is one of Australia's largest hyperscale campuses, 'delivering high-performance digital infrastructure at scale' and 'supporting global hyperscale and enterprise operators', and links the NSW Planning Portal project 'Lane Cove West Data Centre' (SSD-9741). Its progress list records site infrastructure from November 2019, Shell A completed February 2021, Shell B completed May 2023, Shell D completed June 2024 and, for April 2026, 'Current site with Shell C under construction'. A separate section says the Apollo Place data centre (2026 - ongoing) has been located adjacent to 'AirTrunk's existing facility at 1 Sirius Road' as Phase 5 of its investment in the precinct.
sources.date_semantics: Yoast structured data gives datePublished 2019-11-18T21:16:45Z and dateModified 2026-08-19T03:12:55Z, matching the airtrunk.com location-sitemap lastmod (captured 22 October 2026). The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 14 August 2026, which carries the preceding version (dateModified 2026-07-24T02:51:00Z) with the same facility statements, and above by the Internet Archive copy of 1 October 2026 and this live capture, which carry the 19 August version. published_at records the modification day of the captured version; its present-tense description of an operating hyperscale campus with service-level availability is used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 19 August 2026, not an inspection day or opening date (the page dates the first shell to February 2021). The April 2026 Shell C entry is a dated construction note outside the admission window and is not used as a status.

sources.summary: The national health institute's opinion in the VIA of the 'Data Center Stack Campus Siziano (PV)' (ID_VIP 14473) states that the project comprises the construction of the new sites MIL07 and MIL08A, the expansion of the existing sites MIL01, MIL02 and MIL03 and of the site MIL08B, which is currently being built, an extension of the power line between MIL01 and MIL08 and a new substation in Lacchiarella. It records that MIL08A's generators were reduced from 19 to 18 in the updated design, that SCR NOx abatement is planned for MIL07, MIL07+ and MIL08A only, and that excavation, foundations, underground tanks, services and CFA bored piles are expected in the MIL07 and MIL08A areas. It asks for further clarifications and reports no permit, start of works or operation for MIL08A.

sources.publisher: Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML10) S.r.l. (filing published on the MASE VA portal)
sources.attribution: Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML10) S.r.l. / MASE Portale Valutazioni e Autorizzazioni Ambientali
sources.summary: The revised air-dispersion study for Data Center ML10x prints, in UTM zone 32N on WGS84, the coordinates of every generator stack (Appendice A3) and the vertices and heights of the buildings used for building downwash (Appendice A4) for ML10x and the neighbouring Equinix ML5-6, ML7-8 and ML9 buildings and other nearby data centres. The ML10x blocks are a central office block (ML10x_1), east and west server cells (ML10x_2_1, ML10x_2_2), two electrical-room blocks (ML10x_3_1, ML10x_3_2) and four generator gantries; all 16 ML10x stacks (ML10_G1-ML10_G16, representing the 32 planned generators) fall inside the gantry outlines. The area-weighted centroid of the five main blocks is WGS84 9.0347199, 45.4769341, inside the central office block. The study models a construction scenario and normal, maintenance and emergency operation; it is not a record of works.
sources.date_semantics: Document dated September 2026 (PDF created 10 September 2026), part of the integrations received on 11 September 2026 and listed on the portal on 12 October 2026. Locator only; not a status observation.

sources.title: Progetto 'Data Center ML10x del Comune di Settimo Milanese (già ML10 e ML11)': Sintesi non tecnica (Rev. 2026, September 2026), Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML10) S.r.l., ID_VIP 14381
sources.publisher: Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML10) S.r.l. (filing published on the MASE VA portal)
sources.attribution: Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML10) S.r.l. / MASE Portale Valutazioni e Autorizzazioni Ambientali
sources.summary: The revised non-technical summary says Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML10) S.r.l. intends to build a data centre named ML10x in the west of Settimo Milanese, in the former Italtel industrial zone 'Il Castelletto', on an area of about 5 ha now registered as Catasto Terreni foglio 15 particella 55 (formerly mappali 7, 55 and 56), comparto 7B of the Piano Attuativo 'Castelletto Uno'. The redesigned project is a single data-centre building (two two-storey server cells east and west of a central two-storey office block, electrical rooms to the south and 32 generators of 3 MWe on gantries along the south of the lot) with 64 IT UPS, fed by two 220 kV cables from the already-authorised user substation MLSS2. The former Italtel Building 2 was demolished in 2023 and a smaller BT building remains. The lot is bounded by via privata Marisa Bellisario (north), via Monzoro (west), a Vantage DC lot (south) and the Equinix Hyperscale 2 (ML7) S.r.l. lot (east). The start of works is planned for the third quarter of 2028; the project also requires an integrated environmental authorisation (AIA).
sources.date_semantics: Document dated September 2026 (PDF created 11 September 2026), listed on the portal on 12 October 2026 with the integrations. Identity, layout and lot context; the planned 2028 works start is a schedule, not a stage.
